# Ordinary graphic mask source fixtures

A/B/C are derivatives of retained Premiere 26.5.1 saves: XML-derived hypotheses,
then Premiere-saved and independently AME-rendered; UI authoring/inspection is
not claimed. Only the checker still's two absolute aliases were removed; its
`./jrb2083_checker_80.png` RelativePath and all graphic records remain unchanged.
Gzip was regenerated with mtime zero.

Sequence: `c8acf9c1-34b2-4086-9f55-d528950a7059`.
A covers ordinary Shape mask roles; B covers identity SubGroup b0 and uniform
Text b3–b5. B b1/b2 cover owner-only Shape attachments and inversion; C c1
covers the same graphic-frame mask after a rotated/scaled owner.
